what: the day's ranked clusters, in the desk's own one line, sources counted and linked (Jack, 5 October 2026)
what_a_wire_line_is: Each line is the desk's own one-line summary of a story it ranked, with its sources counted and linked. It is not a story the desk wrote or checked; only the item with a badge was checked.

items.line: Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, BBVA commit $270M to Project Faro, a US dollar stablecoin venture targeting first-half 2027 launch.
titles: Goldman Sachs, Citi among banks said to commit $270 million to stablecoin venture
Banks Commit $270 Million to Stablecoin Venture: Report
Goldman, Citi and Global Banks Commit $270 Million to Challenge Crypto’s Stablecoin Giants
Global Banks Goldman Sachs, Citigroup and More Commit $270,000,000 to Joint Stablecoin Venture

items.line: Bitcoin Core disclosed three patched security vulnerabilities, including a high-severity mining bug affecting block template creation.
titles: Bitcoin Core discloses three patched security flaws, including high-severity mining bug
A High-Severity Bug Could Have Stalled Bitcoin Mining—Bitcoin Core Has a Fix
Bitcoin Core Breaks Silence on Three Patched Security Vulnerabilities

items.line: Russia's central bank cleared exchanges to begin organized cryptocurrency trading on Nov. 22, ahead of Moscow Exchange's planned December 1 bitcoin launch.
titles: Russia’s Central Bank Clears Exchange to Open Bitcoin and Crypto Trading on Nov. 22

items.line: Deutsche Bank switched on digital asset custody service for institutional and corporate clients in Europe, holding Bitcoin, Ethereum, and select stablecoins.
titles: Deutsche Bank goes live with digital asset custody service, signs asset management deal

items.line: Nvidia stock fell after New York Times reported CEO Jensen Huang had an affair with internal executive Kimberly Powell, escalating governance concerns.
titles: Nvidia Falls After Report of Huang Affair With Executive
Nvidia stock falls 4.5% after reports of another Jensen Huang affair: NYT

items.line: Bitcoin spot ETF outflows extended to a fourth day as hot CPI lifted rate-hike odds to 90%, while liquidations jumped and BTC held near $74,000.
titles: Bitcoin sits out stock rebound as ETF outflows extend to fourth day

checked.says: U.Today reports Bitcoin Core disclosed three patched security flaws including high-severity CVE-2025-62861 that could disrupt mining by creating inconsistent mempool state after blockchain reorganization.
checked.unconfirmed: The exact impact scope and number of affected nodes in production, and whether the bug was ever exploited in the wild before patching.
